canonical_grain: one exchange-qualified security_id × local trade_date × source_version
join: security_id is the exchange-qualified symbol; resolve aliases and board membership with dated identity rows; join at security_id and effective_from <= trade_date < effective_to_exclusive; assert no same-priority overlap
as_of: a decision at t may use only records whose first_published_at and relevant revision_published_at are <= decision timestamp; local trade_date alone is not a publication timestamp
authority: exchange effective notice or daily static-reference row for trading regime, issuer/exchange announcement for risk-warning effective date, historical listing notice for existence; AmazingData status is corroboration only until conflicts resolved
conflict_precedence: retain both sources and quarantine conflicts; never auto-shift a vendor field by one day or silently select a current-name value
missing: UNKNOWN; exclude from eligible research, including missing bar, missing status, or missing publication time
coverage_gaps: normal-to-ST and *ST effective-date examples not source-validated
full historical board/code transitions not inventoried
delisting-period and relisting exceptions not covered
2026 main-board risk-warning rule transition requires dated mapping
